newsitem.title: JAPAN: Alpine Electronics 96/97 group net seen sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Electronics 96/97 group net seen sharply up.

text.p: Alpine Electronics Inc is expected to post a group net profit of about 2.3 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, almost three times larger than that of the previous year, a Japanese business daily said on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the expected rise in the car audio equipment maker's group profit was because of robust shipments and improvements in its overseas business due to the weaker yen.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available for comment.
Alpine posted an actual group net profit of 800 million yen in 1995/96.
Alpine is 47.3 percent owned by Alps Electric Co Ltd.
